Symbiotic Biomedicine.note: Symbiotic Biomedicine (Symbiox) is a privately held, clinical-stage biomedical company that has not been acquired.

Vuelo Pharma.note: Originally founded in 2000 as Membracel Produtos Biotecnológicos, the company rebranded as Vuelo Pharma and remains independently operated by its co-owners.

Cuprina Holdings.note: Cuprina Holdings operates as an independent company listed on Nasdaq and recently announced agreements to acquire other healthcare entities.

Lohmann & Rauscher GmbH.note: Lohmann & Rauscher GmbH operates as an independent, privately-owned international medical products company.

Reskin Medical NV/SA.note: Reskin Medical NV/SA operates as an independent Belgian specialist manufacturer of silicone wound dressings.
